The café was short-staffed, as usual. Mara took orders, carried plates, and wiped a trail of spilled cocoa from beneath a table while the manager counted the till. She placed it on the kitchen counter and made tea she forgot to drink. The café had taught her to keep moving when things went wrong. It had not taught her what to do when there was nowhere to move.
